question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you like the name Twin Branches?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. At least I made it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just wish I didn't feel like a mushy, bruised banana right before I talk to Justin...
Sam bolts for the gap in the mob, but she gets slammed from the side.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Aah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She crawls through the mob, trying to avoid getting stepped on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who wears spiked heels to school?!
Finally, she crawls out of the crowd, ending up just outside Justin's door!
Sam bolts for the gap in the mob, but she gets slammed from the side.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Aah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She crawls through the mob, trying to avoid getting stepped on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who wears spiked heels to school?!
Finally, she crawls out of the crowd, ending up just outside Justin's door!
Sam bolts for the gap in the mob, but she gets slammed from the side.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Aah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She crawls through the mob, trying to avoid getting stepped on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who wears spiked heels to school?!
Finally, she crawls out of the crowd, ending up just outside Justin's door!
Sam bolts for the gap and emerges on the other side, clear of the mob!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I made it!
Sam hesitates...
And gets slammed from the side!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Ahh!`
She crawls through the mob, trying to avoid getting stepped on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who wears spiked heels to school?!
Finally she crawls out of the crowd, ending up just outside Justin's door!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Where'd she go?! Where is she?
Out of the corner of her eye, Sam sees Jacob craning to find her in the crowd...
As he does so, he moves from his spot, leaving behind a small gap...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Daylight!
Sam tries to slip between the two bodies, but they squeeze together, sandwiching her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam slips between the two bodies, nestling into the middle of the mob!
Sam tries to slip between the two bodies, but they squeeze together, sandwiching her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam hesitates!
The bodies around Sam slam into her, knocking her to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Oof!`
She rises to her feet, now halfway through the mob!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that was lucky.
She rubs her hurt arm.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Kind of...
As the mob shifts, another gap opens between two bodies...
She heads left and pushes through the outer wall of the mob!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in!
She tries to get to the hole, but misjudges, and an elbow hits her in the rib as she pushes through the outer wall of the mob.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...
She tries to jump into the mob, landing in a pile of elbows and knees!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Ow! Ow! Ow!`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least I'm closer to the door...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You shouldn't talk to me anymore. If you don't know why now, you will soon...
Nick turns and leaves. Sam calls out to him...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, that's it?! We're done?!
He doesn't turn around...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine! See if I care! You're... You're just a heartless Spartan!
Sam watches him disappear around a corner...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick...
She returns to the mob...
And is met with a sea of angry faces!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Why were you talking to that Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: They're all scumbags, Sam! They totally tried to cheat us in the Spartan Games!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wait wait wait... Tell me you're not planning on spending the money on `them.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait wait wait... Tell me you're not planning on spending the money on [color=#e23b3b][i]them.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: She wouldn't do that, Jacob. We just chanted not to, remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's `my` decision.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] decision.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Not according to Justin... I heard he's already spending the money for you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!
Sam heads toward Justin's office, but is blocked by the mob.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Move out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Nobody move! She's going to spend the money on Spartans!
Sam tries to push through the mob, but it doesn't budge...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't let her in, guys!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just have to find the empty spaces!
Sam sees a hole to her left!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's exactly it! I'm afraid, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I can't bear the thought of you giving up everything that comes from winning the Spartan Games because of us...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Especially since we don't even know if there really is an us at all.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't get to decide all by yourself whether we're worth risking or not!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You might be right, but I have. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're jealous that I won, and you didn't!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm not jealous, Sam! I'm trying to do you a favor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What favor is that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm trying to make sure you get what I never will... A high school experience where people actually care about you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Where they actually like you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This isn't jealousy. Jealousy doesn't feel like this.
Nick shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't get it. It's not about the money...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Right now, there is an `us` and a `them.` But you're an us, and I'm a them. We're on opposite sides.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right now, there is an [color=#e23b3b][i]us[/i][/color] and a [color=#e23b3b][i]them.[/i][/color] But you're an us, and I'm a them. We're on opposite sides.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's what this whole thing's been about... A war that Centerscore won and Spartan lost.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What just happened... Those dumb guys being dumb guys... I was dealing with that at Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now I'm dealing with that here, from dumb Centerscorians `and` from even dumber Spartans, and I'll keep on dealing with it until I can get out of here and go to college `if` I'm lucky.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'm dealing with that here, from dumb Centerscorians [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] from even dumber Spartans, and I'll keep on dealing with it until I can get out of here and go to college [color=#e23b3b][i]if[/i][/color] I'm lucky.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: The last thing I'm going to do is bring you down with me. Everyone loves you... You've even got your own mob now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, what... You're just going to prevent `us` from ever happening because you're...
nodes.text_bbcode: So, what... You're just going to prevent [color=#3b78e2][i]us[/i][/color] from ever happening because you're...

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I could never do something like that!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: That's comforting to know. For a second, I thought I'd been wrong about you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Only if you thought I wasn't interested in you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I know how you feel... But we're not going to happen, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't tell me I'm wrong about how you feel because I'm pretty sure you like me...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe I do...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, if it's about what they were chanting, I know it was mean. For what it's worth, I'm planning on spending some of the money on you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You can't have both, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Both?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You can't chant something like, 'No money for Spartans,' `and` tell me that you like me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't chant something like, 'No money for Spartans,' [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] tell me that you like me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I wasn't... Wait... You thought `I` was chanting?!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I wasn't... Wait... You thought [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was chanting?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I saw you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You actually think I wouldn't give you any of the money?!
Sam manages to quickly chew the cupcake, swallowing the last of it down!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, Jessica! I'm not going to spend the prize money on converting the science lab into a dance club! It's a ridiculous idea!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why? It's not like science ever did anything valuable!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A dance club is completely impractical!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine then!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We're not going to go clubbing at school?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's okay! I usually just assume I'm in a dance club anyway!
Amanda does a little dance in her seat.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love this song!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can I get some milk here?
Jessica's face turns to all smiles, and she slides the carton to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Stop now! All of you! This has gone on long enough!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've decided how I'm going to spend the prize money...
The chanting stops.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Stop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Stop![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...
A container of applesauce flies through the air and splatters all over Sam!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: How do you like them apples?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: She's an apple turnover!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Shut up, Spartan! You're not getting any money, remember?!
The chanting resumes!
As Sam gets up to leave, Jessica grabs her arm.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just don't forget your roots, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. I won't.
Sam turns back toward the swim team table, but stops in her tracks. The cafeteria falls deathly silent.
Across the way, the Spartans have entered. The whole school glares at them.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Geez... Who died?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Don't you all have something better to do?!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Let it go, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: This sucks.
Nick trails in behind them...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Awww, Nick...
After the Spartans get their food, they sit at the empty tables at the cafeteria's edge.
All of the Centerscore students in their area get up and move to different tables.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is so awkward...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I almost feel bad for them...
Then it starts...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!
The chant rises in volume, just as it did before...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No honey for Martians!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's it! Time to shut this crowd up!
Sam gets up and stands defiantly in front of the Spartan tables, positioning herself between both groups...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had a lot of anger issues, most of them caused by Taylor... But really, they all `came from` me. I was constantly combative and angry...
nodes.text_bbcode: I had a lot of anger issues, most of them caused by Taylor... But really, they all [color=#3b78e2][i]came from[/i][/color] me. I was constantly combative and angry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to go back to that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Especially now that I've found the real me with swimming...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you through, Miss Perfect Actress?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not acting!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Boo hoo hoo! 'My name is Sam, and I'd be with you guys, if I weren't so flawed!'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please! You didn't like cheerleading because you didn't like Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And now you're trying to be polite, but we know it's because you don't like us!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not it at all!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why'd we even invite her over here?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Go back to the swim table, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't believe it! The rumors are true! Celebrities `are` mean!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe it! The rumors are true! Celebrities [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] mean!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine! Bye!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What drama?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... I don't know what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about meetings where boys are ranked by hotness?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wait... By drama do you mean fun?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I would mean fun if they were harmless, but those rankings determine all your behavior toward guys.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatever. Is that it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about gossiping about other girls behind their back?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We don't do that!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, usually we just do it right to their ugly faces!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole! Not helping!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine! But that's it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm sure you as Head Cheerleader makes for a drama-free experience.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Totes!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if I asked all the other girls?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh. I think that proves my point.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmmf!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sounds like approval to me! Thanks, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Now I'll totally, like, `enjoy` school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'll totally, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]enjoy[/i][/color] school!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmmf! Mmmmf!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I bet we could even invite guys from other schools!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course!
Unable to chew the cupcake fast enough, Sam spits it out across the table!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: O.M... Gross.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awkward...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll never wash my face again!
$ZOE grabs the carton of milk and slides it across the table to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! I'm sorry, Sam! I didn't realize you needed that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure you didn't...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, a dance club sounds cool, but I can't spend the money on that!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But you promised!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Way to kill the party mood, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't... Ugh. Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Just make sure that you remember who your real friends are when you're handing out the money...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I will...
The swim team leaves...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Phew... Who knew there would be this much pressure?!
The bell rings for lunch...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Finally!
At lunch, Sam is contemplating where to sit when all eyes turn to her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I should have just lost the Spartan Games on purpose... I could have stayed in that cabin with Nick, flirting...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Instead, he and I are over before we even started, `and` to top it off, I called him heartless...
nodes.text_bbcode: Instead, he and I are over before we even started, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] to top it off, I called him heartless...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam! Over here! Come sit with the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And now Jessica is acting nice to me... That's not weird at all...
Sam walks over and sits down at the Center Table in between Amanda and Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hi, Sam! I've never sat next to a celebrity before, so I'm recording every moment with my mind!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Amanda, I'm still the same Sam. You've known me for years!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Phew! Thank you! I was running out of space in my head!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: First, I think we all want to say congratulations, you're a hero, and blah blah blah.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah, way to go, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We all knew you'd win!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But enough boring speech stuff! $ZOE baked some cupcakes with your face on them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here you go, Sam!
$ZOE hands Sam a plate of cupcakes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow! These are scarily realistic.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was able to make them so detailed because Howard bought me a special tip for my piping bag!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wow, cupcake much?
Sam grabs a cupcake and stuffs it into her mouth...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmm!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, Sam, we totes had the best idea! What if we turned that boring old science lab the nerds are always sciencing in into, like, a dance club?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmmf mmmf mmmf?!
Sam reaches for a nearby carton of milk, but Jessica slyly slides it away and pours herself a glass...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It seems like you like it! Can we count on your approval then?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Dance club!
Sam tries to chew the cupcake, so she can answer Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Mfff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mfff![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't spit out the cupcake! If I do, I'll never hear the end of it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I spend all of the money on the swim team, think about how resentful everyone's going to feel toward us.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I didn't even think of that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You probably won't be able to walk down the hall without getting dirty looks.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Dirty looks?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, Hannah... Not that kind of dirty.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that's not fun!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't want my reputation ruined. I barely have one as it is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've totally got the swim team's back, trust me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Aww. We trust you, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Sara. What about the rest of you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess we trust you...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sure. You've always been a team player...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, we trust you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good! I'll take that.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: After the Spartan Games, does anyone really care about being nice anymore?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I do!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I think Hannah's got a point, even if it is veiled...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sam, you entered a grueling, multi-day battle royale and barely managed to escape with your life!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... It was just a paintball match...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! The time for being nice has passed!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Linda, you don't feel this way too, do you?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I don't think Centerscore's ever going to be the same again. It might be time to think about ourselves...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe that I'm suddenly the nice one in this group!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I was being nice...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shh, don't interrupt me, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Maybe you're getting soft, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe you're getting mean, Hannah!
The door swings open, and Principal Shapiro storms into the office.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Justin! What's this I've been hearing about you assuming authority over Samantha's prize money?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're just a common student! I should be the one to act on your behalf! I'm the President!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, you're acting like a dictator!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: When the people can't govern themselves properly, someone needs to step up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, so you're better? You're elite, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe I am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know who you sound like, Justin? You sound like one of them!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I do not!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You just claimed to be an elite, `and` you called me common. If that doesn't earn you your Spartan ID card, I don't know what does...
nodes.text_bbcode: You just claimed to be an elite, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] you called me common. If that doesn't earn you your Spartan ID card, I don't know what does...

nodes.text: Justin sighs...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam. You're right. I do sound like them. I just can't stand the idea of them getting anything out of this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not a big Spartan fan either, you know?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, just... Just remember how they treated us, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry. I'm not going to forget anytime soon...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So then... You're going to stop spending `my` money?
nodes.text_bbcode: So then... You're going to stop spending [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] money?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah. It's all yours.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They deserve nothing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not `every` Spartan is bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] Spartan is bad.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I get it. `Nick` isn't bad. `Nick` is different. Well, you're blind.
nodes.text_bbcode: I get it. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nick[/i][/color] isn't bad. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nick[/i][/color] is different. Well, you're blind.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They're all jerks! Chad's a jerk! Preston's just a jerk with glasses! And that Carson's just a jerk with a sense of humor!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Nick's probably just a jerk with a lovely haircut!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're wrong about him...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You don't like his hair?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I meant he's not a jerk!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And the rest of them?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Do I need to bring up Mark Backbutter?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Fine! They suck, okay?! But have you thought about how it would go if the situation were reversed?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I think they'd be laughing in our faces as they spent the money on lavish things the school doesn't need!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's... Probably true...
And bursts in!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Stop what you're doing!
Justin freezes, about to bite into a blueberry bagel!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Poison bagel! Assassination attempt!
He hurls the bagel into the wall!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, I meant, 'Stop doling out the money `I` won.' I'd say I'm sorry about your lost bagel, but I'd be lying.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I meant, 'Stop doling out the money [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] won.' I'd say I'm sorry about your lost bagel, but I'd be lying.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're too late. I've already drafted up a memo that gives the money to programs I know are run by `true` Centerscore students...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're too late. I've already drafted up a memo that gives the money to programs I know are run by [color=#e23b3b][i]true[/i][/color] Centerscore students...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Things like football, Hector's Party Fund, and this new club... Citizens Against Dumb Spartans... Or C.A.D.S.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not too late, Justin. You can destroy the memo!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You know, ever since I saw that televised kiss between you and Nick, I've had my misgivings about you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because I kissed Nick?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Because you kissed a Spartan! They duped us, Sam! They tricked us into playing their crooked game!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If it weren't for the shady manner of your victory, we'd be under `their` lame thumbs!
nodes.text_bbcode: If it weren't for the shady manner of your victory, we'd be under [color=#e23b3b][i]their[/i][/color] lame thumbs!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're welcome.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I wasn't being nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what, then? You've just decided to ignore the rules and divvy up my prize money how you see fit?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If that's what it takes to keep them from getting any funding, yes!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Justin, you're being unfair...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Sam turns the doorknob to Justin's office...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Listen, I should probably sit somewhere else...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! Wait! Stay just another moment!
Sam reluctantly stays seated. Jessica leans forward...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sam, we really like you, and we're concerned about the relationship between you and us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I remember how tense it was when Taylor was Head Cheerleader, but it's not like that anymore, I assure you.
Slowly, as if on cue, the girls grab up $ZOE's cupcakes and begin eating them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you getting at?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We want you to come back to the cheerleading team!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We could have so much fun together! Just like old times!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's just like a party every day!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I would be so nervous cheering next to someone famous!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You have to come back!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We could gossip about guys together!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That all sounds good... But I know the real reason why you're all suddenly being extra nice to me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You want to make sure I give some of the prize money to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Jessica?! Is that why you had me bake these cupcakes?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shh, $ZOE! Not now!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I can't come back to cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't you like us?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's not that... She just thinks she's better than us now that she's got some popularity!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is that it, Sam? Do you think you're better than us?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I don't. I just don't think cheerleading is good for me. When I was in cheerleading, I really hated...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But before I tell you, I have a few things to say...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've `never` been more embarrassed to be a Centerscore student than I've been today.
nodes.text_bbcode: I've [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] been more embarrassed to be a Centerscore student than I've been today.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All I've heard all day long is 'We deserve this' and 'We need that'!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, we do need that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Amanda! Not the time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know the swim team needs a swimming pool...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And a trip to...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A swimming pool!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know the cheerleaders need... Well, they don't need an on-campus dance club...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That was at the top of our request list!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know they actually need a new sound system!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Blech.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's better than nothing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How are you this cheerful?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know the nerds need seismic monitor whatevers...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whoop!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know the football team needs a new field.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's right, Samface!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know all of this because you kissed up to me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And while you were all kissing up to me, you were also telling me that the Spartans shouldn't get anything!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: They shouldn't!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's hard not to deny them every cent, given their behavior... But they're still people!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, we didn't really do anything...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Zip it, Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So yeah, some of the Spartans are ginormous jerks...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But they need new horseshoes for their horses...
Some of the crowd starts booing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is what I'm talking about.
Sam looks at Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone told me today that there will always be an us and a them...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But they were wrong.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The problem isn't whether I should give money to the Spartans.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We need to realize right now...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...That there aren't any more Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We brought them into our school... That means they're a part of us now!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Spartans... Are Lizards now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, they are! But there also isn't really a Centerscore anymore either!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoa, Sam! What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: As of right now, this school is no longer called Centerscore.
Sam sees Principal Shapiro standing in the back of the cafeteria. Shapiro nods at Sam with a smile.
The crowd buzzes with excitement!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are we called?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're... We're Twin Branches now. Two schools that are part of the same tree.
Angie stands up...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Kind of like when you make a choice and there are two `branching` paths that extend off of it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Kind of like when you make a choice and there are two [color=#3b78e2][i]branching[/i][/color] paths that extend off of it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That came from nowhere, but yes, like that too.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about the money?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Simple. Everyone gets the small things that they want.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Seriously? No dance club?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Deal with it. It's `my` choice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Deal with it. It's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] choice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm choosing to use the money to try to heal our wounds... Instead of just making them deeper.
A small wave of protest goes up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. I'm not changing my mind. This is final.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So instead of whining and complaining and begging... I suggest you start getting to know each other. Because we're all in this together now.
As the groups whisper amongst themselves, Sam goes over to Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Nick. I didn't mean to call you heartless. I think you've got a big heart.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, no worries. I'd have been pissed off too if a girl who liked me ended things before they even got started.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, you do like me?
Nick blushes.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let's change the subject... I have to say, what you just did was probably the most impressive thing I've seen today.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Today only, huh?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe this week...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on. I want to show you something...
Nick gets up and follows Sam toward the cafeteria exit...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you think everyone will be okay?
They look back... Erik gets up from his seat and sits down in between Chad and Carson.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hi! I'm Erik! I'm a Capricorn! That's the sea-goat!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know about you guys, but if I ever saw a real-life sea-goat, I'd probably swim away...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Or run away... You know depending on whether I saw it in the ocean or on land.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's with this guy?
Howard sits down across from Chad...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He'll grow on you. Anyway, welcome to Center... I mean, Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Uh, thanks.
Sam smiles...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it's going to be different. But I think it'll be okay.
A few minutes later, Sam leads Nick into the music room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This is... The music room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the new photography lab!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I told you I'd make sure some of the money went toward you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But you didn't know we'd be simpatico...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That doesn't change the fact that you needed this.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, this is definitely the `new` most impressive thing I've seen today.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, this is definitely the [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] most impressive thing I've seen today.

nodes.text: Nick looks around the room...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just imagining what this room will look like with computers, photographs, and cameras...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah, there aren't any cameras in here... That reminds me...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was just thinking we could share our first off-screen kiss...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I only kiss with an audience.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up and get over here...
Nick holds Sam around the waist, and the two of them kiss for a long, long time...
Wow! Sam bridged the gap between Spartan and Centerscore and created `Twin Branches!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow! Sam bridged the gap between Spartan and Centerscore and created [b]Twin Branches![/b]

nodes.text: Not only that, but things are heating up between her and Nick!
And all thanks to you! With everyone's eyes on the prize, you kept Sam's heart where it mattered most! You played a great game!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to spend the money on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Myself!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Myself![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's so selfish!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But... Our dance club?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This decision is too hard. It's apparent that all of you are either self-centered, cold-hearted, or worse, Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Therefore, I don't see anyone worthy of the prize money... Except me, of course!
While the crowd sits there stunned, Sam turns to exit the cafeteria... Nick grabs her arm as she passes...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam? Are you sure you want to do this? You're going to send the school into chaos!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't see any alternative. Besides, how bad could it get?
A few weeks later...
Sam's helicopter touches down in the middle of the football field!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Awesome! After my vacation in Italy, I feel so well-rested! Sleeping in helps too, now that I can get to school in two minutes!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey! We're practicing here! You can't land a helicopter at midfield!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just did! What are you going to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And think real hard before answering, Zach, because I can spend money on things to make the football field `worse` than it already is!
nodes.text_bbcode: And think real hard before answering, Zach, because I can spend money on things to make the football field [color=#3b78e2][i]worse[/i][/color] than it already is!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Worse? How?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... I heard Dex was interested in studying the sleeping patterns of gophers. This field seems like the kind of fertile soil they'd enjoy.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Grrr... I don't have any complaints.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good.
As Sam heads toward the school, Zach calls out to her...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to go there without a pad and helmet?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Heh. You'll see!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Dumb jock!
Sam steps into the hall, but it's completely empty...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where is everyone?
The moment Sam reaches the middle of the hall, she hears a war cry!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Spartans! Attack! No mercy!
Doors and lockers swing open, and Sam gets riddled with paintballs!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We got another one!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: The uprising continues! Spartans forever!
Nick appears at the end of the hall...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! Look at what they've done to me!
He pulls out a paintball gun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! Not you too!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam... There's an us and a them. I'm with us. And you're with them.
He pulls the trigger, and paint spills red onto Sam's chest... Right over her heart...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Noooooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Noooooo![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Well, Sam tried to combat selfishness with some selfishness of her own...
But it doesn't look like the pleasure of spending the money on herself was worth ruining Centerscore!

nodes.text: She's going to spend the money on Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: How she spends the money is up to her!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: No buts! It's Samantha's choice! I expect better from you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Fine...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now, I'm pretty sure you two both have classes to attend to.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You remember class, right? The place you go to with the desks, books, and a teacher.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, Principal Shapiro, I remember class.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Good. That's something to get me through my day...
Later, as class wraps up, the girls from the swim team surround Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, girls!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hey, yourself!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Did you promise the Spartans that you were going to spend all the money on caviar, helicopters, and their own customized bathrooms?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I don't even know what a customized bathroom is!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: If I had a customized bathroom, it would be filled with guys!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Zero surprise all around.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There are a lot of rumors swirling around about where the money's going, and we just wanted to make sure you spend it on swim team stuff!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We can't keep swimming in my dad's backyard pool!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I agree...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Then it's settled. All the money goes toward the swim team's new Olympic-sized pool... And as a bonus, toward a trip to Italy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait, I didn't say anything about...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Italian guys are `so` hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh! Italian guys are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know! Just look at Matteo!
Matteo heads out of the room, noticing as the girls stare at him... He mumbles to himself as he leaves.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not understand this country...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You guys! I'm not going to spend the money on a trip to Italy! I'm probably not going to spend it on an `Olympic`-sized pool either...
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys! I'm not going to spend the money on a trip to Italy! I'm probably not going to spend it on an [color=#3b78e2][i]Olympic[/i][/color]-sized pool either...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What are you going to spend it on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know... I'll probably spend it on something we `need.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know... I'll probably spend it on something we [color=#3b78e2][i]need.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like a `normal-sized` pool... But I don't want to spend all of the money on the swim team!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like a [color=#3b78e2][i]normal-sized[/i][/color] pool... But I don't want to spend all of the money on the swim team!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because that's not...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's okay, Principal Shapiro... I lost my head for a little bit, but Sam brought me back down to earth.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Samantha, is this true?
Justin gives Sam a pleading look...
Score Up!

Now that Centerscore and Spartans have come together to co-exist, let's see how they're getting along!
After school, Hector and Carson are talking...
Even though I'm happy with Amanda, I still help struggling guys out with the ladies, using my six-part attraction technique, the H.E.C.T.O.R. method!
It's never failed! For a small fee, I'll let you in on the secrets, my new party pal!
I'd take your offer if I wasn't also in the attraction business, bro. My system,`The C.A.R.S.O.N`, is perfect.
The C.A.R.S.O.N?
Yeah. You tell me yours, I'll tell you mine?
You're on! You first!
It's simple... `C`heetah fur coat, `A`ftershave from Burma, `R`hinestones, `S`nakeskin wallet, `O`strich eggs... Always keep one nearby, and `N`ever upset your limo driver.
Pretty self-explanatory, right?
Uh, yeah... Mine's pretty much the same stuff.
On the football field, Chad, wearing football pads, rides his horse up to the football players.
Hey, guys. What position do you think suits me best?
Dude! How many times do I have to tell you?! There aren't any horses in football!
Are you sure? How are you supposed to get from one end of this big field to the other?
You run!
That... That can't be right. I'd perspire!
The football players shake their heads.
Uh... Why do you have a mallet?
To, you know, hit the ol' pigskin around. That's a phrase, right?
Forget the mallet. What position do you think you'd be good at? Quarterback? Runningback? Cornerback?
Uh... Horseback? Is that a position?
The football players sigh...
This is going to take a while...
Meanwhile, in the science lab, Preston and the rest of the nerds huddle around a complicated gizmo.
Excellent circuitry work on the seismic activity monitor, Dex!
Thanks! We should be able to capture even tiny tremors with this vibra-tab.
And you can monitor earthquake frequencies with the oscilloscope?
Precisely! This needle over here lets us know if there are any significant shifts in the tectonic plates!
I never thought I'd say this... But could we be `less` nerdy and just play some Ogres 'N' Elves?
Sure!
The nerds set themselves up around an expansive fantasy map...
If I remember correctly, my one-armed giant had just discovered a friendly troop of orcs!
Erik! They tied you to a stick and danced around it, wielding torches and drooling. I don't think they're friendly... I think they're planning on eating you.
They'll change their minds once they see that I'm friendly too!
Don't worry, Erik... My mage is cloaked among the orcs. I'll save you!
As the nerds get wrapped up in play, no one is watching Dex's seismic activity monitor...
No one sees the needle begin to twitch...
Slightly at first, then more...
And more!
What does this mean for Twin Branches?! Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That wasn't too bad...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now it's time to deal with Justin!

nodes.text: But whatever you do... `Don't wait!` In one week, the two genres with the fewest votes `will be eliminated...`

nodes.text: So vote now... And make sure the story you want to play wins!
And now...

nodes.title: Eyes on the Prize
nodes.subtitle: What should Sam do with the $100,000 prize money?

nodes.text: The day after winning the Spartan Games, Sam strides into the school...
And gets mobbed by cheering, clapping students!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks, cuz!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Sam! Would you sign my poster?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There are posters of me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... But all I had on me was this poster of an owl. It says 'Party `Fowl`'?! Ha! What a `hoot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... But all I had on me was this poster of an owl. It says 'Party [color=#e23b3b][i]Fowl[/i][/color]'?! Ha! What a [color=#e23b3b][i]hoot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Shut up, nerd! Sam, you really crushed those Spartan punks! `And` you looked hot doing it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up, nerd! Sam, you really crushed those Spartan punks! [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] you looked hot doing it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um, thanks, and... Ew.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Way to represent Centerscore, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah! What kind of pool are you going to buy us?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pool? I think Samface knows the money should go to a new football field!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Or toward upgrading my seismic activity monitor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, everyone, I don't know how I'm going to spend the money yet...
Sam sees Nick walking alone toward class...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick!
He doesn't hear her. She tries to push through the crowd toward him, but she can't get through.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Move, people!
Just then, Zach and Jacob pass Nick. Jacob reaches out and slaps Nick's books to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha! What are you going to do about that, Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'll probably pick them up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's `real` clever. How's it feel knowing you lost $100,000 to us?
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] clever. How's it feel knowing you lost $100,000 to us?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Meh. I don't really care one way or another.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You will when you see all the cool stuff we get while you and all your Spartan pals get nothing!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah! No money for Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I like that! No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!
Soon the chant is picked up by the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No money for Spartans! No money for Spartans!
Nick turns and sees Sam looking at him from the center of the chanting crowd!
He walks away, the hurt unmistakable...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! Wait!
Sam breaks free of the crowd and reaches Nick! He turns around...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't understand...
